decision: Retain the Spanish las and French elles headwords; remove the 7,736 other candidate-index-only memberships. An attached pronoun in a verb form, or a coincidental character sequence inside another word, is not a lexical descendant of the Latin pronoun.
review_method: Full-list structural review of both language member arrays and their evidence, with contrasting lexical examples. This is a family-level decision; excluded words were not each independently etymologically annotated.
evidence_invariant: Each original membership has exactly one component. Every evidence record is from candidate_index, has a path ending in the appropriate headword twice, and is compound_morphology or morphological_parse. No direct etymological record is being discarded from this member array.
